questions.stem: Which of the following polymers is prepared by condensation polymerization?
questions.solution: Nylon 6,6 is a condensation copolymer prepared by the condensation of hexamethylenediamine and adipic acid with the elimination of water molecules. Teflon, Buna-N, and Neoprene are addition polymers.

questions.stem:
Among the following, the total number of condensation polymers is ________.
Nylon 6, Nylon 6,6, Terylene, Teflon, Neoprene, Novolac, Buna-S
questions.solution:
Condensation polymers are formed by repeated condensation reactions between different bi-functional or tri-functional monomeric units with the elimination of small molecules like water, alcohol, etc.
Condensation polymers in the list: Nylon 6, Nylon 6,6, Terylene, and Novolac.
Addition polymers: Teflon, Neoprene, Buna-S.
Total number = 4.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a copolymer?
questions.solution: Buna-S is formed by the copolymerization of 1,3-butadiene and styrene (two different monomers). Polythene, PVC, and Neoprene are homopolymers formed from a single type of monomer.
